Electrical supplies

Power cables, conduits, distribution boards, circuit protection and earthing hardware for building and site installations.

Overview

Equip residential developments, commercial buildings and construction sites with dependable electrical installation materials. We supply cables, containment conduits, distribution switchgear and earthing components matched to your electrical engineer’s schedule.

Typical specifications & range

Wiring & power cables
Single-core and multi-core PVC/XLPE copper cables (1.5 mm² – 35 mm²+) and SWA armoured cables
Cable containment
Heavy-duty uPVC and galvanised steel conduits (20 mm – 50 mm), surface trunking and cable trays
Distribution & protection
Consumer units, 3-phase distribution boards, MCBs, MCCBs, RCDs and isolator switches
Earthing & accessories
Copper-bond earth rods, earth mats, clamps, weatherproof junction boxes, switches and sockets

Common applications

  • 01First-fix and second-fix building electrical wiring
  • 02Sub-main power distribution and switchgear panels
  • 03Temporary site power and exterior lighting networks
  • 04Lightning protection and electrical earthing systems

For an accurate quote

What to include

  • Itemised electrical schedule or BoQ
  • Cable cross-section (mm²), core count and insulation/armouring type
  • Ratings, pole counts and preferred standards for switchgear
  • Quantities in coils, metres or units
